---
name: Experiment proposal
about: Propose a reproducible experiment with controls and decision criteria
title: "[Experiment] "
---

## Question and branch
What quantity or decision is being investigated?

## Current evidence
Proposed, synthetic or physical? Link the relevant proof-register item.

## Apparatus and reference
What exists, what is missing, and what is the independent comparator?

## Controls and independent units
Describe confounders, randomization, specimens/sessions and held-out evaluation.

## Criteria and data plan
Define success/stop criteria before confirmatory work. Include calibration, raw records and uncertainty.

## Resources and scope
Describe equipment, permissions and relevant laboratory constraints. Do not include confidential or identifiable data.
